chapter: Flute, world instruments and first recordings
title: First recording date for Savoy in 1955
summary: His first recording as leader, made on off nights at Hackensack with Wilbur Harden and others.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Merchants, yeah. Absolutely. Have sound, will travel. So, by the mid-‘50s you’ve, you’ve uh, your first recording date’s in 1955.
On Savoy, and uh, now, you’re still in Detroit at this time?
Yes, and we would travel to New York on our off night, and record. Hackensack.
Who was in uh, in the band at the time of your, your first recording?
Uh it was Ernie Farrell on bass, Hugh Lawson–piano. Will Austin–bass, Louis Hayes–drums. Um...it was uh Wilbur Harden...
Those have just been reissued, have they not?
